interactions.mechanism: Alcohol potentiates metformin's effect on lactate metabolism, elevating risk of fatal lactic acidosis.
Significantly increases statin plasma concentrations, raising risk of severe rhabdomyolysis.
Additive hyperkalemic effect; frequent serum potassium monitoring required.
NSAIDs decrease antihypertensive efficacy of ACE inhibitors and increase acute nephrotoxicity risk.
Calcium salts bind levothyroxine in gastrointestinal tract, reducing bioavailability. Separate by at least 4 hours.
